title: chat lock
description: A simple chat management plugin that lets OPs toggle the chat lock with one command — when locked, only OPs can chat and all messages from regular players are blocked.
body:
# 🔒 Chat Lock

A lightweight chat management plugin for Paper servers.
Lock the chat instantly with one command — only OPs can talk when locked.

---

## ✨ Features
- 🔒 **Toggle chat lock** with one command
- 📢 **Broadcasts** to all players when chat is locked or unlocked
- 🔓 **OPs can always chat** — even when locked
- 💬 **Fully configurable** messages

---

## 📋 Commands

| Command | Description |
|---------|-------------|
| `/chatlock` | Toggle chat lock on/off |

---

## ⚙ Config

- Customize all **messages** (locked, unlocked, blocked)

---

## 📌 Setup
- Paper 1.21 — 1.21.11
- Java 21+

---
